applies_why: The judge text issues RESULT: DEFENDER WINS, so the RESULT rule governs whether that result is permitted.
quote: STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — reading one: the retracted BROKEN grade retracts the standing's stated reason 'link C3 was broken,' so the standing does not count; reading two: the retraction affects only the collision grade while the standing text still asserts non-self-support, so it counts.
why: The text awards DEFENDER WINS while the only stated basis for that result is a challenger standing whose reason (the D2-vs-C3 BROKEN grade) is expressly retracted and corrected to HELD-1, so the standing does not count and no valid condition for DEFENDER WINS remains.
